2608.12974.title: Comment on "Modeling rapid language learning by distilling Bayesian priors into artificial neural networks"
2608.12974.paper_summary: McCoy & Griffiths (2025, henceforth M&G) suggest that a Bayesian prior can be distilled into Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) through Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (MAML, Finn et al., 2017). They support this empirically by showing that meta-trained networks demonstrate formal language learning abilities comparable to Yang & Piantadosi (2023)'s Bayesian learner, significantly outperforming standard ANNs. We point out that under the standard interpretation of a prior, M&G's procedure does not actually instill one; it merely initializes network weights favorably, leaving the objective function unchanged. We then consider a more permissive interpretation, where the system as a whole can be seen as implementing a Bayesian learner even without an explicit prior in the objective. We show that this interpretation faces nontrivial challenges. Finally, we assess how well MAML approximates the empirical results of Bayesian learning, showing that unlike genuine Bayesian learners, M&G's model overfits and generalizes poorly to unseen data.
2608.12974.paper_summary_zh: McCoy & Griffiths (2025，以下簡稱 M&G) 建議可以通過模型無關的元學習 (MAML, Finn et al., 2017) 將貝葉斯先驗提煉成人工神經網絡 (ANNs)。他們通過實證支持這一觀點，顯示出元訓練的網絡展現出與 Yang & Piantadosi (2023) 的貝葉斯學習者相當的形式語言學習能力，顯著超越了標準的 ANNs。我們指出，在對先驗的標準解釋下，M&G 的程序實際上並沒有灌輸一個先驗；它僅僅是有利地初始化了網絡權重，而沒有改變目標函數。然後，我們考慮一種更寬鬆的解釋，其中整個系統可以被視為即使在目標中沒有明確的先驗也在實施一個貝葉斯學習者。我們展示了這種解釋面臨非平凡的挑戰。最後，我們評估 MAML 在多大程度上近似於貝葉斯學習的實證結果，顯示出與真正的貝葉斯學習者不同，M&G 的模型過度擬合並且對未見數據的泛化能力較差。
